The Jacobian minors force \(s=u=v=y=0\) at every singular point. Because the second equation has linear term \(s\), formal elimination leaves cubic initial form \(u^3+uv^2+vy^2\), so the local multiplicity is exactly \(3\). The included verifier rechecks these identities.
